The block is positioned with its bottom face at Z=0 and top face at Z=12. The block footprint is centered at X=20, Y=15.

features.placement: Centered at (20, 15) in XY. Extends from Z=0 to Z=12 (through the entire thickness).

connections: The opening is a subtractive feature from the block_body.
The opening axis is parallel to the Z axis (thickness direction).
edit_rules: If block width (X) changes, the opening X center must remain at width/2.
If block depth (Y) changes, the opening Y center must remain at depth/2.
If block thickness (Z) changes, the opening depth must update to match the new thickness (maintaining through-hole status).
